notes.title: 3D overlays now available in the Open Beta.
notes.content:
Experimental support for 3D overlays from a stereo camera source is now available for testing in the Open Beta.

Read more details in the Open Beta thread:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/844060/discussions/0/1642044369663273755/

notes.title: Reality Blender 0.2
notes.content:
-Improve video texture quality.
-Fix input issues in UI.
-Show info in Overlay and Backdrop edit modes.
-New camera library AVPro:
Allows exposure setting to be adjusted to help improve camera framerate.
Should provide more compatibility for different camera brands.

notes.title: Released to Early Access!
notes.content:
Reality Blender has its first release on Steam Early Access.

It is very early days for this software so please try it out for free and let me know if you have any issues in the forums.

I consider this the first step and of course the future goal is to have stereo cameras giving us full 3D video of our pit while in VR.
